$comment: Overlay of the ccpshanghai registry's carbon-blueexposure 2.1.1#2 with one more patch, android-interface-typeinfo-anchors.patch: IList, IPythonMethods and IPythonNumeric gain a key function and default visibility so their vtable/typeinfo live only in blue.so. On Android every library carried a private copy and dynamic_cast to them inside blue.so returned nullptr for engine-created objects (the app's first device run crashed in IList_Thunk::Pyappend, M6 Plan 3 Task 7). Overlay ports win regardless of version; port-version 3 is there so the package's version string and ABI hash differ from the registry's #2. Delete this overlay once the registry's carbon-blueexposure carries the patch (the same route Plan 2 took for carbon-core#7).
name: carbon-blueexposure
